item.title: Cyclist dies after accident with bus along Admiralty Drive, driver assisting police investigations
item.description: On Saturday (29 Nov) morning, a cyclist died after being involved in an accident with a bus along Admiralty Drive in Sembawang.

item.title: 3 sent to hospital after tall vehicle hits tree branch along ECP, causing it to fall on 5 cars
item.description: Three people were sent to the hospital after a tall vehicle hit a tree branch along the ECP, causing it to fall on five cars behind.

item.title: PAB rider dies after accident with car in Tampines, driver allegedly fled on foot
item.description: A PAB rider has died after an accident with a car in Tampines, with the car driver allegedly fleeing on foot without rendering assistance.

item.title: S$41K worth of illegal cough syrup & prescription medicines seized at Yishun & Changi Airport
item.description: S$41,000 worth of illegal cough syrup and prescription medicines were seized at Yishun and Changi Airport in separate cases.

item.title: Student in Thailand repeatedly slashed with cutter after pulling down classmate's trousers in prank
item.description: A student in Thailand was slashed with a cutter by a classmate after he pulled down the classmate's trousers in a playful prank.

item.title: USS Battlestar Galactica ride stalls mid-air for over 30 mins, 16 riders have to walk down tracks in rain
item.description: 16 riders were evacuated from Universal Studios Singapore’s Battlestar Galactica ride on 28 Nov after it stalled mid-air, with no injuries.

item.title: Man in Japan arrested for filling tea bottle with urine & placing it back on convenience store shelf
item.description: A 26-year-old man in Japan has been arrested after filling a plastic tea bottle with urine and placing it on a convenience store shelf.

item.title: S'pore secondary school teacher charged with loan shark harassment, left pork & threat note at Dawson flat
item.description: A secondary school teacher from St Patrick’s School has been charged with loan shark harassment of a Dawson Road resident.

item.title: M‘sian couple's bridal vehicle gets stuck on speed bump due modified car's low chassis
item.description: A newlywed couple in Malaysia faced a wedding day mishap when their modified bridal vehicle got stuck on a speed bump due to its low chassis.

item.title: Father in US leaves toddler inside burning car after accident, claims 'no one' was inside
item.description: A father in the United States has been sentenced to 22 years behind bars after he left his 2-year-old daughter inside his burning car.
